decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an evolution of the established BASIC 518 trommel screen, which already had a loyal following, so it fits the firm's core mobile screening line and is likely to stay.
The AK high-speed shredder series is a long-standing core line that was recently upgraded to EU Stage V engines, which shows continued investment.
The mobile high-speed grinder got its own page in 2019 and supports the firm's biomass and green-waste customers, though overlap with other grinders adds some risk of consolidation.
The CERON stationary pre-shredder generation was promoted as setting benchmarks and is already in use in plant installations, which supports the firm's plant-based business.
